title: Typed configuration and secrets loader
goal: All services read configuration through one typed, validated loader with defaults, documented keys and a safe way to inject secrets.
scope_in: `defineConfig(schema)` helper (zod) that parses `process.env` once at startup, applies defaults, and throws a single aggregated error listing every invalid key (names only, never values).
Base config sections: node env, service name, log level, HTTP port/host, `PUBLIC_API_URL`, `DATABASE_URL`, `REDIS_URL`, trusted-proxy settings, `REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS`.

Secret handling: any `FOO` may be supplied as `FOO_FILE` (path to a file, trimmed) for Docker/Fly secrets; secrets are wrapped in a `Secret<T>` type whose toString/toJSON/inspect output is `[redacted]`.
`.env.example` with names only and a generated `docs/config.md` table (key, type, default, required, secret).
Rule that other lanes declare their own keys with `defineConfig` in their module (no central edits).
scope_out: Per-feature keys (JWT keys, Stripe, R2, email): owned by the lane that uses them, declared with this helper.
Loading secrets from a cloud secret manager (infra lane).
build_against: Pure unit tests with an injected env object; no files or network except a temp dir for *_FILE tests.
interfaces: `defineConfig<S extends ZodTypeAny>(schema: S, env?: Record<string,string|undefined>): z.infer<S>`.
`class Secret<T=string> { reveal(): T; toString(): '[redacted]'; toJSON(): '[redacted]' }`; `secretString()` zod helper.
`baseConfig(env?)` returns `{nodeEnv:'development'|'test'|'production', serviceName, logLevel, host, port, publicApiUrl, databaseUrl: Secret, redisUrl: Secret, trustedProxyHops:number}`.
acceptance: With `DATABASE_URL` missing, `baseConfig()` throws ConfigError whose message lists `DATABASE_URL` and not any value from env.
When both `FOO` and `FOO_FILE` are set the file wins; a trailing newline in the file is trimmed; an unreadable file gives ConfigError naming `FOO_FILE`.
Defaults: `PORT` 3000, `LOG_LEVEL` info, `REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS` 30000, `TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS` 1; out-of-range PORT (0 or 70000) is rejected.
In `production`, a `DATABASE_URL` without `sslmode=require` or a `REDIS_URL` not starting with `rediss://` is rejected unless `ALLOW_INSECURE_BACKENDS=1`.
`pnpm --filter @centcom/core gen:config-docs` rewrites docs/config.md; a test fails if docs/config.md is stale vs the schema.
The parsed config object is deep-frozen; assigning to it throws in strict mode.
tests: define.test.ts: aggregate errors, defaults, coercion of ints/bools.
secret.test.ts: redaction under JSON, inspect, template string, structured clone.
docs-fresh.test.ts: generated table equals committed docs/config.md.
guardrails: MUST NOT include config values (especially secrets) in any error message, log or thrown object.

MUST parse env exactly once at process start and pass the object by injection; MUST NOT read process.env anywhere else in the codebase (lint rule `no-process-env` outside entrypoints and this package).
MUST NOT commit real values in .env.example; names and harmless placeholders only.
MUST reject unknown NODE_ENV values rather than defaulting to development in production.
failure_modes: Invalid config -> process exits non-zero at startup (entrypoint catches ConfigError), before opening ports.
Secret file permissions too open (world-readable) in production -> log a warning with the key name only.
Env value with only whitespace -> treated as unset.
